about: This prayer asks that receiving the Body of Christ bring neither judgment nor condemnation, but protection and healing. Its wording recalls 1 Corinthians 11:29, where Saint Paul warns against receiving unworthily.

seg.tr: The reception of Your Body, Lord Jesus Christ, which I, though unworthy, dare to receive,
may it bring me neither judgment nor condemnation:

ex.w016: The word used in 1 Corinthians 11:29 for unworthy reception.

seg.tr: but because of Your goodness, may it protect my mind and body and bring me healing:
who, being God, live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit for ever and ever. Amen.
